form.label: Cyber Data Catalog - Promote HF/EP Candidate
form.description: Reviews a DC-98 discovered candidate, then promotes it into dc_infra_nodes_lookup, logs the event to dc_lifecycle_events, and marks the candidate as promoted so it drops off the pending list. Writes to the KV Store directly - never touches the git-managed seed CSV.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_infra_candidates_lookup where status="pending_review" | table candidate_id | sort candidate_id

input.label: Host (FQDN) - copy from the reference table below

panel.title: Pending candidates - reference (copy host/evidence into the fields above)

search.query: | inputlookup dc_infra_candidates_lookup where status="pending_review" | table candidate_id host suspected_type confidence uhgid_guess possible_ae_match evidence events_seen first_seen last_seen | sort candidate_id

| makeresults | eval node_id="$candidate_id$", node_name="$node_name$", node_type="$node_type$", uhgid="$uhgid$", ae_name="$ae_name$", environment="$environment$", role="$role$", host="$host$", declared_tier="$declared_tier$", technical_owner="$technical_owner$", backup_owner="$backup_owner$", datacenter_site="$datacenter_site$", ha_pair_id="$ha_pair_id$", status="active", lifecycle_state="onboarded", onboard_date=now(), last_reviewed=now(), notes="$notes$", dataset_count=0, tier0_datasets_behind_node=0 | eval _key=node_id | table _key node_id node_name node_type uhgid ae_name environment role host declared_tier technical_owner backup_owner datacenter_site ha_pair_id status lifecycle_state onboard_date last_reviewed notes dataset_count tier0_datasets_behind_node | outputlookup append=t dc_infra_nodes_lookup | table node_id node_name node_type host declared_tier technical_owner status

| makeresults | eval event_id="evt|"."$candidate_id$"."|".now(), scope_type="infra_node", scope_value="$candidate_id$", event_type="onboarded", event_date=now(), from_state="candidate", to_state="active", ticket="$change_ticket$", performed_by="$performed_by$", notes="Promoted from DC-98 discovery. ".("$notes$") | eval _key=event_id | table _key event_id scope_type scope_value event_type event_date from_state to_state ticket performed_by notes | outputlookup append=t dc_lifecycle_events_lookup | table event_id event_type scope_value ticket performed_by

| inputlookup dc_infra_candidates_lookup | eval status=if(candidate_id="$candidate_id$","promoted",status) | outputlookup dc_infra_candidates_lookup | where candidate_id="$candidate_id$" | table candidate_id host status
